title: Support
subtitle: We're here to help. Find answers or reach out to our team.

faq.question: How do I download your games?
faq.answer: Road Hopper, Bank Hopper and Time Hopper are live on Google Play. Arena Legends is in Google Play Closed Testing: submit your Google Play email on our Beta page to be invited. Visit our Apps page or search 'SouMoster' on the Play Store.

faq.question: How do I join Arena Legends Closed Testing?
faq.answer: Submit the Google Play email on your Android phone on our Beta page and select Arena Legends. We add you to the tester list, then you opt in from the link and install from Google Play.

faq.question: Where can I watch trailers and gameplay?
faq.answer: Follow SouMosterGames on YouTube at youtube.com/@SouMosterGames for trailers, gameplay, and developer videos.

faq.question: Are your games free?
faq.answer: Yes, our games are free to download and play. Some games may offer optional in-app purchases for cosmetic items.

faq.question: How can I report a bug?
faq.answer: Use the bug report form on our Support page or email us at soumoster@gmail.com with a description and screenshots.

faq.question: Can I request a new feature?
faq.answer: Absolutely! Submit a feature request through our Support page. We review all suggestions and prioritize based on community feedback.

faq.question: What is your typical response time?
faq.answer: We aim to respond to all support inquiries within 24–48 hours.

faq.question: Do you support older Android devices?
faq.answer: We support Android 7.0 (API 24) and above. Specific requirements are listed on each app's Google Play page.
